text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm working in my office, Sakura Chiyono O comes barging in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Here's a lesson for you: "The juiciest orange is a front runner!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If you eat through a box of oranges too slowly, they'll all get moldy before you know it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why you have to eat them while they're ripe and in season! That goes for enjoying other things while they're in season too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Anyway, are you free this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's December, and you know what that means…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Tis the season! The holiday season, to be exact!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look! The lights over there are gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! There are a bunch of winter sales going on too! Why don't we go take a peek?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. How could I not be? I want to enjoy this as much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …After all, seasons come and go in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If we're only allowed to enjoy certain things at certain times, then I want to take full advantage of them while I can.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And if I'm with you, I feel like I can experience the season in a more grown-up fashion. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't act like you don't know what I'm talking about! C'mon, take me to a ritzy cafe that kids can't go to, please?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to enjoy the holidays somewhere other than the arcade or shopping mall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If anything, Chiyono's pleas make her seem more childish, but I agree to look for a place that will suit her wishes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: M-mayhaps this is s-simply my imagination, b-b-but wouldn't you say this eatery is a tad, um, e-extravagant?
choice_data_list: Why are you talking like that?

text_block_list.name: Waitstaff
text_block_list.text: May I take your drink order, miss?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… I'll have a milk tea, p-please…

text_block_list.name: Waitstaff
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll be right back with your tea. Please enjoy yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew… I really feel like I've leveled up in maturity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Falalala! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh. This song…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I recognize it too. It's a popular song this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hear it all the time, but listening to it here somehow makes it feel special.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is such a special, unknown place to me. Imagine if a spell had been cast over here to stop time from flowing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then this day would last forever. Next year would never come, and time would just keep repeating itself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yes, that's true. I know better than that.

text_block_list.name: Waitstaff
text_block_list.text: Here is your milk tea. I'll leave it on the table for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-oh, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: See? Now my milk tea is here.
choice_data_list: Some things only happen due to the passage of time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Like my milk tea arriving?
choice_data_list: Yes. Drink it before it gets cold.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's sweet, but so light and refreshing.
choice_data_list: Even that flavor is thanks to the passage of time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah… Hehe. Yes, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While listening to the festive music, Sakura Chiyono O drinks all of her milk tea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: See? Now my milk tea is here.
choice_data_list: Some things only happen due to the passage of time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Like my milk tea arriving?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Brrr! It sure has gotten cold out here.
choice_data_list: Well, it was really warm inside.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: True… Wait!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow! How beautiful! Look at that! The lights are different than they were this afternoon…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh… I must only be able to see them like this because of the passage of time too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see… It's stunning…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're so mature, Trainer. You know so much more than I do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I guess I'll keep getting more mature with time too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: When I think that I might grow to be more like you, it makes me look forward to it a little.
